feed.headline: Analysis: Trump's shock Russia deal highlights mounting pressure to curb fuel prices
feed.ai: The US president hopes to ease his party's pain before next month's midterm elections, writes the BBC's North America correspondent.

feed.headline: Why Trump Made a Diesel Deal With Putin
feed.ai: Our national security and White House correspondent David E. Sanger breaks down why President Donald Trump struck a deal with President Vladimir V. Putin to import Russian diesel fuel in the coming months, despite having signed recent congressional legislation tightening energy sanctions on Russia.

feed.headline: Germany puts Ukrainian on trial accused of blowing up Nord Stream pipelines
feed.ai: Four years after the attacks, Serhii Kuznetsov appears in court accused of a plot to destroy Russia's gas pipelines to Germany.

feed.headline: Turkish police raid opposition TV station, halting live broadcasts
feed.ai: It is the latest in a series of crackdowns on media critical of the Turkish president and his government.

feed.headline: Burnham treads carefully with Zelensky visit, balancing Trump and Ukraine
feed.ai: The UK's prime minister meets with Volodymyr Zelensky after a rocky week for the Ukraine president.

feed.headline: Russia arrests Japanese journalist on spying charges
feed.ai: The Hokkaido Shimbun journalist is accused of collecting information on Moscow's defence capabilities for Tokyo.

feed.headline: Why Moscow is staying tight-lipped on Trump's energy ceasefire
feed.ai: While Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelensky suggests he would sign up to a ceasefire on energy infrastructure, Russia has said little.

feed.headline: Why the prime minister wants to talk about Brexit again
feed.ai: For the first time since the UK left the EU, we have a prime minister who will "unflinchingly" debate Brexit, says the BBC's political editor Chris Mason.

feed.headline: Nord Stream trial: How German police followed the evidence - to Ukraine
feed.ai: After four years, a Ukrainian man is set to stand trial in Hamburg accused of sabotaging the Nord Stream pipelines.

feed.headline: Chinese Carmakers, Once a Sideshow, Take Center Stage at Paris Motor Show
feed.ai: At this week’s Paris Motor Show, there are no signs the influx of low-cost Chinese vehicles will slow despite European Union efforts.

feed.headline: Zelensky Says Ukraine Will Resume Russian Refinery Strikes, Defying Trump
feed.ai: President Volodymyr Zelensky made the announcement in an interview with The Financial Times. He had paused the strikes to comply with a demand from the United States.

feed.headline: Azerbaijan engineers rare summit with in-conflict Middle East and Asian leaders
feed.ai: Israel and Iran have met for a rare “confidence-building measures” summit in Baku, with Azerbaijan saying it serves as “a connecting hub in the Eurasian space.”
